summary: the memory suite's two stack-overrun cases, machine.memory.stackoverrun-fork and stackoverrun-boot, on i686, whose double fault has a task gate, with faults in the guard pages and in vector 8's gate

argv: ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 && ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel

faults.name: guard-mapped
faults.summary: kalloc_guarded mapping the guard page below a stack like the pages above it, which breaks the fork case

faults.name: boot-guard-mapped
faults.summary: guard_boot_stack leaving the page below the boot stack mapped, which breaks the boot case

faults.name: interrupt-gate
faults.summary: vector 8 given an interrupt gate that runs on the stack in use, in place of its task gate, which breaks both cases, since the double fault then faults a third time
